name: Paper diorama hero
summary: A full-screen hero where a cut-paper landscape builds behind a headline that is readable from the first paint. Birds drift once the scene is built.

source.title: Paper diorama video prompt ("AI city paper diorama"), posted on Threads

source.notes: The source post shares an AI video prompt and the video it made. This is a CSS and SVG rebuild of the look and motion, written from scratch; no prompt text, frames or assets were copied.
